title: Momogun language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sabah, Malaysia
extract: Kimaragang (Marigang), Tobilung, and Rungus are varieties of a single Austronesian language of Sabah, Malaysia. The three varieties share moderate mutual intelligibility. Children are not learning it well in some areas.
